title.narrative: Action Document for the continuation of health support for refugees in Türkiye

description.narrative: This action aims to enhance the health and well-being of all refugees, aligning with SDG 3 on Good Health and Well-being. It seeks to improve the health status of refugees in Türkiye through the provision of high-quality healthcare services, and the reinforcement of the Turkish Ministry of Health's capacity. This endeavour builds upon ongoing EU assistance for refugee health, initiated in 2016. Drawing from the collaborative efforts of SIHHAT I, II and III with the Turkish Ministry of Health (MoH), its overarching objective is to ameliorate the health conditions of refugees in Türkiye, with four specific aims:·      Continuing and enhancing immunisation services for refugees, recognising it as a critical outcome of primary healthcare;·      Continuing and enhancing reproductive health services as a priority area of the SIHHAT action;·      Integrating the health records of refugees living in Türkiye into the Turkish health system;·      Strengthening the MoH's capacity to generate and manage evidence and knowledge crucial for migrant health policymaking.Starting from 2017, funding for immunisation services from SIHHAT budget has significantly improved the well-being of the migrant population, as acknowledged by the Republic of Türkiye. This initiative is vital in preventing contagious diseases among the migrant population and maintaining the current health of the host community, particularly in the wake of the 2023 earthquakes disaster.
